name: SDIT Weekly Ops — Backlog, P1/P2 Resolution, Time Logged, Changes

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = SDIT AND type IN ("[System] Incident", "[System] Service request", "[System] Service request with approvals") AND statusCategory != Done

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =project = SDIT AND type = "[System] Incident" AND priority = P1 AND cf[11006] = "Sistemes" AND resolved >= "{{ $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.weekStart }}" AND resolved <= "{{ $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.weekEnd }}"

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =project = SDIT AND type = "[System] Incident" AND priority IN (P1, P2) AND cf[11006] = "Sistemes" AND resolved >= "{{ $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.weekStart }}" AND resolved <= "{{ $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.weekEnd }}"

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =project = SDIT AND worklogDate >= "{{ $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.weekStart }}" AND worklogDate <= "{{ $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.weekEnd }}"

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = SDIT AND type = "[System] Change" AND statusCategory != Done

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: project = SDIT AND type = "[System] Change" AND statusCategory != Done AND dueDate IS EMPTY

parameters.jsCode:
const allItems = $input.all().map(item => item.json);
return [{ json: { items: allItems, workflow_id: 'jira-sdit-weekly-ops' } }];

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'ok', week: $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.week, year: $('Calculate Week Range').first().json.year, result: $json }) }}
